SELECT p.id, p.post_type AS postType, p.title, p.views, p.created_at AS createdAt, u.nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id AND c.deleted = 0 ) AS commentCount FROM user_posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND p.post_type = #{postType}
ORDER BY p.views DESC
ORDER BY commentCount DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at ASC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

AND post_type = #{postType}
